how_to_apply: Fill the application in duplicate in the Bio-Data Proforma enclosed with the advertisement.
Attach complete and up to date Confidential Reports/APARs countersigned by the employer.
Employer verifies and certifies the particulars, no pending disciplinary/vigilance case and penalties of the last 10 years.
Forward the application through proper channel.
Send to Principal Director (Pers), HQ Integrated Defence Staff, Ministry of Defence, Room No. 33, Kashmir House, Rajaji Marg, New Delhi-110011 within 60 days of the advertisement.
Make sure it reaches by 19 January 2027.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date, without Confidential Reports or incomplete will not be considered Only officers who could be spared in the event of selection should be forwarded Officers already on deputation must apply through the parent cadre/Department

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D Degree (in relevant field); Professor or Associate Professor with a total service or experience of at least fifteen years of teaching or research in Universities, Colleges and other institutions of higher education; minimum ten research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals; minimum 110 research score as per latest UGC notification Experience: Professor or Associate Professor with a total service or experience of at least fifteen years of teaching or research in Universities, Colleges and other institutions of higher education; and (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the Parent Cadre/Department, or (ii) 2 years' regular service in Level 13A (Rs.1,31,100-2,16,600) or equivalent, or (iii) three years' regular service in Level 13 (Rs. 1,18,500-2,14,100) or equivalent Age limit: Maximum 58 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open to officers of Central/State Government, Union Territories, autonomous or statutory organisations, PSUs, Universities or Recognized Research Institutions Form: officers under Central/State Governments are only eligible for Absorption; candidates of non-Government Organisations are eligible only for Short Term Contract

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding shall ordinarily not exceed five years Terms governed by DOP&T OM No.6/8/2009-Estt(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, amended from time to time Post is Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial

content_sections.heading: How Will MoD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications/Work Experience in the CV will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in duplicate in the Bio-Data Proforma Complete and up to date Confidential Reports/APARs countersigned by the employer Copy of Degree Certificate Details of major/minor penalties of the last 10 years Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate for officers already on deputation Latest salary slip if the organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, without Confidential Reports or incomplete will not be considered Only officers who could be spared in the event of selection should be forwarded Officers already on deputation must apply through the parent cadre/Department
